_comment: Device Setup card of the BrickMic backend, drawn by emtk over setup_forms.BrickMicSetupForm. Bounds are BrickMicSetupModel.FIELDS (test_setup_specs.py keeps them equal). Replaces the hand-drawn card and, before it, the Qt BrickMicSetupDialog.

sections.text: BrickMic hardware acquisition and SPC output settings. Apply writes these values to the selected BrickMic backend.

sections.title: Hardware acquisition
sections.description: Counters, rate and buffer of the BrickMic backend.

sections.label: Start counter index
sections.description: Start counter index, 0 to 31. Press Enter or click elsewhere to commit; Apply writes it to the BrickMic backend.

sections.label: End counter index
sections.description: End counter index, 0 to 31. Press Enter or click elsewhere to commit; Apply writes it to the BrickMic backend.

sections.label: Acquisition rate (Hz)
sections.description: Acquisition rate (Hz), 1,000 to 5,000,000. Press Enter or click elsewhere to commit; Apply writes it to the BrickMic backend.

sections.label: Buffer size / channel
sections.description: Buffer size / channel, 10,000 to 20,000,000. Press Enter or click elsewhere to commit; Apply writes it to the BrickMic backend.

sections.title: SPC file output
sections.description: How the photon stream is split into .spc files.

sections.label: Photons per .spc file
sections.description: Photons per .spc file, 1,000 to 1,000,000,000. Press Enter or click elsewhere to commit; Apply writes it to the BrickMic backend.
Channels follow the counter window (end - start + 1); Apply writes them with the rest.
What the last action did, or why it did not.

buttons.label: Apply
buttons.description: Write validated hardware acquisition and SPC output settings to the selected BrickMic backend.

buttons.label: OK / close
buttons.description: Close device setup. Only settings already committed with Apply affect the device or acquisition.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Close this card without applying pending device-setting edits; earlier Apply operations remain in effect.
